people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

people.name: Nebat
people.line: Father of Jeroboam, the first king of Israel.

translations.web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, in which he made Israel to sin.
translations.bsb: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD and walked in the ways of his father and mother and of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused Israel to sin.
translations.kjv: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin:
translations.asv: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Jehovah, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, wherein he made Israel to sin.
